artifacts.summary: Two-phase route-(b) plan: a fresh-measurement-derived eager_load.baseline_bytes move with a dated note entry, then a known-failures.txt row rewrite (not removal) re-attributing the residual suite failure to the cross-owned gate 24 /ide findings.

memory_candidates.content: verify-deploy.sh gate 20 reads orchestrator-context-budget.json from $TARGET/agent-system/extensions/core/context/config/ (verify-deploy.sh:1777) -- the SOURCE STORE, never the deployed .claude/ copy -- so an eager-budget baseline move needs no deploy sync. Separately: test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh's baseline-fixture-clean case asserts baseline_rc -eq 0 from a full '--max-cost moderate' verify-deploy run, not merely zero gate20 findings. Any unrelated moderate-class gate finding on the real corpus (e.g. gate 24's dead-command-recommendation hits) therefore keeps that case red no matter what the budget config says. Before planning a fix for a suite whose failure looks single-caused, read its baseline block's actual predicate: an absolute rc==0 assertion over a repo-wide gate couples the suite to every standing pre-existing finding in the corpus.
